items.hed: The Rockets host the Jazz at Toyota Center Friday night, carrying their 9-3 start into a stretch where the league office has highlighted Amen Thompson's expanded role alongside Fred VanVleet and Alperen Sengun
items.insight: NBA.com's game preview for tonight's 8:30 p.m. ET tip notes the league is tracking how Houston keeps finding minutes for Thompson as VanVleet, back from his earlier absence, and Sengun anchor the rotation. Utah enters the night well under .500, and Houston's coaching staff has used the stretch to keep testing lineup combinations rather than lock in a set five this early in the season.

items.hed: Marvin Harrison Jr. and Danielle Hunter are both officially out for Sunday's game at Tennessee, while Will Anderson Jr. is questionable after sitting out Friday's practice
items.insight: Houston's final Week 11 injury report lists Harrison (hamstring) and Hunter (hamstring) as out after each did not practice Friday, while Anderson (ankle) is questionable after going from limited to a did-not-participate designation over the week, the team's official injury report shows. Running back David Montgomery (groin) and cornerback Jaylin Smith (hamstring) are also questionable after returning to full practice Friday.

items.hed: Yordan Alvarez's unanimous AL MVP award makes him the first Astros player to win the honor since Jose Altuve in 2017, joining Altuve and Jeff Bagwell as the only MVPs in franchise history
items.insight: Houston Public Media reports Alvarez and NL winner Pete Crow-Armstrong of the Cubs were both unanimous selections, the third year that's happened in both leagues at once, after 2023 and 2024. Alvarez, who played only 48 games last year because of injuries, led the majors in batting average, walks, on-base percentage and slugging percentage this season. “Everybody knows what happened last year,” Alvarez said through an interpreter. “I was anxious to get back to this season, and now we see where that ended up here with an MVP award.”
